### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activity A03 occurred in every trace (200/200) and was always preceded by A02; A02 appeared in all traces at about 80% of the trace length, and A03 at the end. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, POS002, REL001]
- In the later window, A03 no longer appears in any trace (0/200), A02 still appears in all traces but now at the end (position 1.0), and A02 no longer has any observed outgoing transition to A03. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, REL001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that activity A03 was removed from the process (or became so rare as to be absent in 200 traces), and that A02, which previously always preceded A03, now occurs as the final activity. This is directly shown by the disappearance of A03 from all traces, the loss of the A02→A03 edge, and the change in A02's position from before A03 to the end. The evidence cannot rule out that A03 still exists but was not observed in the later window, though 200 traces with zero occurrences make that unlikely.

Other differences: None beyond the removal of A03 and the resulting shift of A02 to the end.
